stories.title: Altcoin profit share falls to 12% as short-term traders take losses
stories.summary: A market metric tracking altcoin profitability dropped to 12%. The fall shows most short-term altcoin traders now hold positions at a loss. CryptoSlate reported the decline on November 5.
stories.whyItMatters: A low profit share often signals trader capitulation and can precede sharp altcoin price swings.
whatToWatch: Whether the profit share stabilizes or falls further
Any pickup in trading volume as a sign of a capitulation bottom
questions: What methodology produced the 12% figure?
Does the drop reflect a broad market pullback or an altcoin-specific issue?

sources.title: Altcoin profit share sinks to 12% as short-term traders take losses

stories.title: Hong Kong requires crypto providers to track customer trades
stories.summary: Hong Kong regulators ordered crypto service providers to monitor and record customer trading activity. The rule adds a new compliance layer for exchanges and platforms operating in the city. CryptoSlate reported the requirement on November 5.
stories.whyItMatters: Hong Kong is a major crypto hub in Asia, so tighter oversight there can shape how other regional regulators treat exchange compliance.
whatToWatch: How exchanges in Hong Kong implement the tracking rules
Whether other Asian regulators introduce similar requirements
questions: What specific trade data must providers track and report?
What is the compliance deadline, and what penalties apply?

sources.title: Hong Kong forces crypto providers to track customer trades

stories.title: Aave and Lido lose $1.7 billion in DeFi capital drop after Binance hack
stories.summary: DeFi lending protocol Aave and staking protocol Lido saw a combined $1.7 billion outflow in deposited capital. CryptoSlate linked the drop to fallout from the Binance hack. The outflow is one of the larger DeFi capital declines tied to a single exchange incident.
stories.whyItMatters: Fast withdrawals from major DeFi protocols can signal contagion risk spreading from a centralized exchange incident into decentralized finance.
whatToWatch: Whether capital returns to Aave and Lido as the Binance situation settles
Other DeFi protocols reporting outflows tied to the hack
questions: What is the confirmed scale and cause of the Binance hack itself?
Did the outflow come from direct Binance exposure or broader risk aversion?

sources.title: Aave and Lido lose $1.7B in massive DeFi capital drop after the Binance hack

stories.title: Weekend stock tokens predict Monday's open correctly just over half the time
stories.summary: Tokenized stock products that trade over the weekend were tested as predictors of Monday's market open. Guessing that prices would rise scored 55% accuracy, little better than a coin flip. CryptoSlate's analysis questions how reliable these tokens are as a forward signal.
stories.whyItMatters: Tokenized stocks are a growing product category, and weak predictive value undercuts one of their pitched uses for traders.
whatToWatch: Further testing of weekend token moves against actual Monday opens
Whether platforms change how they market these tokens given the weak signal
questions: What sample size and time period produced the 55% figure?
Which stock tokens and platforms were included in the analysis?

sources.title: Weekend stock tokens predict Monday open, but guessing up scores 55%

stories.title: Nvidia stock tokens show price spreads, but slippage wipes out arbitrage
stories.summary: Tokenized versions of Nvidia shares have traded at prices that diverge from the underlying stock, creating apparent arbitrage opportunities. CryptoSlate found that slippage, the cost of actually executing trades, erases those potential profits in practice. The finding points to liquidity limits in current stock-token markets.
stories.whyItMatters: It shows tokenized equities still carry real friction costs, tempering claims that these products offer easy cross-market arbitrage.
whatToWatch: Whether liquidity improves enough to narrow the spread-slippage gap
More analyses of other tokenized stocks for the same pattern
questions: How large were the price spreads before slippage was factored in?
Which platforms were used to measure the arbitrage attempt?

sources.title: Nvidia stock tokens show price spreads, but slippage crushes the arbitrage

stories.title: French bank resumes transfers after $133 million attack, crypto loss still unconfirmed
stories.summary: A French bank restored transfer services after a $133 million attack. CryptoSlate reported that the bank has not confirmed whether any stolen funds involved crypto assets. The full scope of the incident remains unclear.
stories.whyItMatters: A confirmed crypto link would tie a major banking loss directly to digital assets, making this worth tracking as details emerge.
whatToWatch: Official confirmation from the bank on whether crypto assets were involved
Any regulatory or law enforcement statements on the attack's cause
questions: What method was used to carry out the $133 million attack?
Which French bank was affected, and has it named a responsible party?

sources.title: French bank resumes transfers after $133 million attack but leaves crypto loss unconfirmed

stories.title: Bitcoin tops $80,000 for first time since Binance hack, but history warns of a crash
stories.summary: Bitcoin rose above $80,000, its first time at that level since the Binance hack, even as Democrats swept recent elections. CryptoSlate noted that historical patterns around similar rallies have preceded sharp crashes. The rebound comes despite the exchange incident that had weighed on prices.
stories.whyItMatters: A fast recovery past a key price level after a major hack, paired with warnings of past crash patterns, matters for anyone gauging near-term market risk.
whatToWatch: Whether Bitcoin holds above $80,000 or reverses as history suggests
Market reaction to policy signals from the newly shifted Congress
questions: What specific historical pattern is being compared to the current rally?
How much of the price move reflects hack recovery versus the election outcome?

sources.title: Bitcoin rockets above $80,000 for first time since Binance hack despite Democrats sweep, but a historical crash looms

stories.title: Pro-crypto candidates win 241 seats as Congress shifts power
stories.summary: Candidates described as pro-crypto won 241 seats in recent elections, according to CryptoSlate. The result marks a shift in the makeup of Congress. The outcome could affect the direction of pending digital-asset legislation.
stories.whyItMatters: Congressional makeup shapes the fate of crypto market-structure and stablecoin bills, so this shift could speed up or reshape pending legislation.
whatToWatch: Which crypto-related bills gain traction under the new Congress
Committee assignments and leadership changes affecting digital-asset policy
questions: What criteria classified a candidate as pro-crypto?
Which chamber or chambers do the 241 seats span?

sources.title: Pro-crypto candidates sweep 241 seats as Congress shifts power

stories.title: Kamino ties most of CEO's token vesting to valuation, leaving holders no revenue claim
stories.summary: Kamino structured most of its CEO's KMNO token vesting schedule to depend on the protocol's valuation. CryptoSlate reported that token holders have no matching claim on foundation revenue. The arrangement raises questions about how incentives align between leadership and token holders.
stories.whyItMatters: Tokenomics that reward executives on valuation while leaving holders without revenue rights are a recurring governance concern in crypto projects.
whatToWatch: Community or investor reaction to the vesting structure
Whether Kamino adjusts the terms or grants holders revenue rights
questions: What valuation milestones trigger the CEO's vesting?
Does any other Kamino stakeholder group hold a revenue claim?

sources.title: Kamino links most of CEO’s KMNO vesting to valuation while holders have no foundation revenue claim

stories.title: US stock perpetuals get the green light, but market halts can still trap traders
stories.summary: US stock perpetual futures products received regulatory clearance, according to CryptoSlate. The report notes that halts in the underlying stock market can still stop traders from exiting positions. The clearance opens the door to wider adoption while leaving this structural risk unresolved.
stories.whyItMatters: These products bridge crypto and equity markets, and exit risk during a stock-market halt is a real concern for traders using them.
whatToWatch: How platforms handle trader exits during a stock-market halt
Adoption and trading volume for US stock perpetuals after clearance
questions: Which regulator granted the clearance, and under what conditions?
Has a halt scenario already caused losses for perpetual traders?

sources.title: US stock perpetuals win clearance, but stock-market halts can still block exits
